name: paat-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for development workflows and productivity

plugins.name: reddit-fetch
plugins.description: Research any topic using Reddit via Antigravity CLI (agy) web search

plugins.name: tribunal-review
plugins.description: Multi-provider code review — three legs selected per risk tier from Codex, Claude (read-only repo-walking), OpenCode Go, Grok, Muse, DeepSeek, Gemini and Qwen, at least two must succeed, with calling-context arbitration

plugins.name: saas-startup-team
plugins.description: Portable SaaS delivery: Plan → Build → Independent Review with bounded maintenance and deterministic legal/PII/spend/release gates

plugins.name: saas-operations
plugins.description: Standalone SaaS operations: monitoring, incident investigation, session replay, support triage, and deduplicated issue filing

plugins.name: lawyer
plugins.description: On-demand Estonian/EU legal risk analysis for SaaS projects via est-saas-datalake and primary sources, with a law registry that flags load-bearing provisions when they change

plugins.name: google-ads-strategist
plugins.description: Senior Google Ads strategist — iterative campaign design + Chrome-based creation in PAUSED state for investor review. Browser verification via Ad Preview Tool, SERP capture, and Ads Transparency Center. Enforces hypothesis discipline, buyer-intent + product-value gates, and accumulates learnings.

plugins.name: silent-failure-scanner
plugins.description: Deterministic diff-time detector for swallowed errors & ghost transactions — flags empty catch / except:pass, removed await, dropped non-2xx responses, and narrative-prose comments across TS/JS, Python, C#, and PHP, with a global PreToolUse commit-gate hook that hands findings to Claude to arbitrate

plugins.name: payment-contract-tester
plugins.description: Research-grounded payment-integration hardening — a skill encoding Montonio/Stripe/Mollie silent-trap knowledge plus runnable contract-test reference fixtures that run green against a correct handler and red against each seeded trap

plugins.name: irreversible-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate that blocks Bash commands with no practical local undo — de-obfuscates ssh/docker-exec transports, heredocs, chains, and env prefixes before matching a tiered deny-set

plugins.name: i18n-parity
plugins.description: Vendorable zero-dependency translation key-parity gate for multilingual next-intl apps — diffs locale catalogs (presence, empty values, ICU args, leaf shape, namespaces) with declarable waivers, wired as a hard CI/pre-push gate

plugins.name: subagent-local-qwen3.8-27b
plugins.description: Drive local llama.cpp Qwen3.8-27B as a coding implementer/reviewer via Qwen Code CLI

plugins.name: multi-model-orchestrator
plugins.description: Route software tasks across Claude, Codex, Grok, Muse, Gemini Flash/Argon, Mistral Vibe, and local models by task fit, reasoning effort, plan-limit headroom, and availability, with independent review

plugins.name: work-item-triage
plugins.description: Evidence-based work-item decisions: decide what deserves implementation or filing, preserve provenance, and hand off a bounded next-action queue.

plugins.name: proton-bridge
plugins.description: Proton Mail Bridge skills — reply drafts over IMAP with reply-all recipients, a "Re:" subject and the original mail quoted (stored in Drafts, never sent), and emails from named senders turned into deduplicated GitHub issues
